name: A04_clip
prompt: 2D animated documentary scene, clean cel shading, bold outlines, flat muted earthy colors, consistent style in every frame. Real-time speed. The bearded teamster in the foreground has just stopped and stands still beside his mule, seen from behind; his shoulders rise and fall with a slow breath and his head tilts slightly as he stares across the creek at the man sitting under the oak. The mule flicks its ears and shifts its weight. The creek water flows steadily and sparkles over the grey stones. The golden grass and the oak leaves stir in a faint breeze. The man sitting against the oak stays completely motionless, like a statue, head bowed. The camera pushes in very slowly toward the oak. Quiet, uneasy late-morning light.
